Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:10:1.hebrew: תנינא - במתניתין: ופודה בו — בשה — פעמים הרבה, שאם חזר וקנאו מיד הכהן לאחר שנתנו לו, חוזר ופודה בו פטר חמור אחר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:10:1.english: We learn - In the Mishnah: "And he may redeem with it" — with a lamb — "many times"; for if he repurchased it from the priest after having given it to him, he may again redeem another firstborn donkey with it.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:10:2.hebrew: ורבי חנינא - דאמר שה אחד של בן לוי כו' — טעמא דמתני' קמפרש, והכי קאמר כו':
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:10:2.english: And Rabbi Ḥanina - Who said, "One lamb of a Levite..." etc., is explaining the reasoning of the Mishnah, and this is what he is saying etc.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:11:1.english: The firstborn were not sanctified - [Those] that were born in the wilderness.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:13:1.hebrew: דמעיקרא - במדבר. והאי "קדש לי כל בכור" מוקי ליה ריש לקיש במצרים, אבל במדבר לא קדשו, מדכתיב "כי יביאך", והדר "והעברת כל פטר רחם":
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:13:1.english: That initially - [That is,] in the wilderness. And this [verse], “Sanctify to Me every firstborn,” Reish Lakish establishes [as applying] in Egypt, but in the wilderness they were not sanctified, since it is written: “When [the Lord] shall bring you,” and then: “And you shall set apart all firstborn of the womb.”

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:14:1.hebrew: בבמות - כל אחד בנה מזבח ומקריב עליו, ומשהוקם המשכן נאסרו, כדכתיב (ויקרא י״ז:ד׳) ואל פתח אהל מועד לא הביאו וגו':
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:14:1.english: [With regard to] altars - Each person would build an altar and sacrifice upon it. And once the Tabernacle was erected, they were forbidden, as it is written: “And to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting he has not brought it...” (Leviticus 17:4).

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:14:2.hebrew: ועבודה בבכורות - בכורי ישראל היו מקריבים, ומכאן ואילך — הכהנים. אלמא, בכורות קדשו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:14:2.english: And the service [was performed] by the firstborn - The firstborn of Israel would offer [the sacrifices], and from that point forward — the priests. Evidently, the firstborn were sanctified.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:15:1.english: For if you do not say so - But rather [that it refers] to those who were born in the wilderness.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:15:2.hebrew: בן שנה בר עבודה - הא משיצאו ממצרים עד שהוקם המשכן, שתא חדא הוא דהואי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:15:2.english: [Is] a one-year-old capable of [sacrificial] service - Behold, from [the time] they left Egypt until the Tabernacle was erected was [only] one year.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:17:1.hebrew: דלא פסיק - קדושת בכורות, דהנך שנולדו במדבר קדשו — איכא למימר: דמעיקרא, שנולדו (במדבר), בקדושתייהו קיימי, כו':
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:17:1.english: That did not cease - The sanctity of the firstborn — that those who were born in the wilderness were sanctified — it can be said that those from earlier, who were born (in the wilderness) [i.e., in Egypt], remained in their sanctity, etc.:

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:19:1.hebrew: ומינה - איכא למשמע דלא קדשו בכורות במדבר, דקתני "אותו היום", מכלל דמכאן ואילך לא קרוב — שיום ראשון הקריבו כל בכורי בהמה שיצאו ממצרים:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:19:1.english: And from it - It can be deduced that firstborns were not sanctified in the wilderness, as it teaches “that day,” implying that from that point forward they were not sacrificed — for on the first day they sacrificed all the firstborn animals that had left Egypt.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:1:1.hebrew: ולדורות מנא לן - שיפטרו בכורי כהנים לוים, דמהאי ק"ו לא שמעינן אלא במדבר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:1:1.english: And from where do we [derive this] for [all] generations - That the firstborn of priests [and] Levites should be exempt; for from this a fortiori argument we only learn [it regarding] the wilderness.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:21:1.hebrew: מעיקרא לא - שלא היה יכול כל אחד לעשות מזבח להקריב בכורות שלו, דחובות לא קרוב בבמת יחיד:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:21:1.english: Initially, not - That an individual was not able to make an altar to sacrifice his firstborn [animals], for obligatory [offerings] were not sacrificed on a private altar.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:23:1.english: They were commanded to sanctify - And actually, [the command was meant] for when they enter the Land.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:23:2.english: [Were they] not sanctified in Egypt - [This is asked] in astonishment: But behold, they all agreed earlier regarding those that left Egypt [that they were sanctified].

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:24:1.hebrew: והכתיב פקוד כל בכור זכר - מבן חדש ומעלה, ובן חדש ודאי במדבר נולד, דהא האי מעשה בשנה שנית הואי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:24:1.english: And isn’t it written: “Count all the firstborn males” - [The verse continues:] “From a month old and upward”; and [one who is] a month old was certainly born in the wilderness, as this event took place in the second year.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:2:1.hebrew: וממאי דבשה - של בן לוי נפטרו פטרי חמורים של ישראל, דקאמרת לעיל: בן לוי דהוה ליה שה, דאפקע ליפקע:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:2:1.english: And from where [is it derived] that with a lamb - of a Levite the firstborn donkeys of the Israelites were exempted, as you said above: “A Levite who had a lamb, which abrogated, let [his own] be abrogated”?

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:2:2.hebrew: כסף לדורות - בבכור אדם, (במדבר י״ח:ט״ו-ט״ז) ופדויו מבן חדש תפדה בערכך כסף חמשת שקלים:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:2:2.english: “Silver” for generations - With regard to a firstborn human (Numbers 18:15–16): “And their redemption price, from a month old shall you redeem, according to your valuation, five shekels of silver.”

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:2:3.english: “A lamb” for [future] generations - (Exodus 13:13) “And [every] firstborn donkey you shall redeem with a lamb.”

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:3:1.hebrew: בכסף פדו בכורים באותה שעה, דכתיב (במדבר ג׳:מ״ז) ולקחת חמשת שקלים לגולגולת:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:3:1.english: With silver they redeemed the firstborn at that time, as it is written (Numbers 3:47): “And you shall take five shekels per head.”

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:4:1.hebrew: הקדשות - (ויקרא כז) ואם המקדיש יגאל את ביתו וגו', ומעשר שני — דכתיב (דברים יד) ונתתה בכסף. הילכך, פדו בו בכורות במדבר כלדורות — תאמר בשה, שאין פודין בו הקדשות:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:4:1.english: Consecrated property - (Leviticus 27): “And if he that consecrated [it] will redeem his house, etc.” And second tithe — as it is written (Deuteronomy 14): “And you shall turn it into silver.” Therefore, they redeemed firstborn with it in the wilderness just as for [later] generations; would you say [the same] of a lamb, with which one cannot redeem consecrated property?

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:6:1.hebrew: תדע - שלא נמנו בכורי בהמת ישראל, מדלא מנה הכתוב עודפים בבהמה, כמו שמנה באדם — שלשה ושבעים ומאתים:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:6:1.english: Know - That the firstborn of the animals of Israel were not counted, since Scripture did not count a surplus among animals, as it counted among humans — two hundred and seventy-three.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:7:1.english: That they did not have - That the Israelites did not have many animals, like the Levites.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:8:1.hebrew: ודילמא אפילו הכי - דמקנה רב היה לבני ראובן, אפ"ה לא הוו עדפי בבהמה, שיהו בכורי בהמת ישראל עודפים על פשוטי בהמות לוים:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:8:1.english: And perhaps even so - That [although] the children of Reuben had a great multitude of livestock, even so they were not surplus in animals, such that the firstborn animals of Israel would be surplus over the ordinary animals of the Levites:

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:9:1.hebrew: ואימא - הא דכתיב "בהמת הלוים", בהמות טובא משמע, כדאשכחן בנינוה (יונה ד): "ובהמה רבה" — אלמא בהמה טובא משמע:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:9:1.english: And say - That which is written, “the cattle of the Levites,” means many animals, as we find regarding Nineveh (Jonah 4): “And many animals” — which proves that [the word] behema means many.

Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:9:2.hebrew: אם כן - דבהמת דלוים (ובהמתן דישראל תרוייהו) טובא משמע, ליכתבינהו קרא כי הדדי. מדשני קרא בדיבוריה, ש"מ חד פטר טובא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 4b:9:2.english: If so - That [the word] behemat of the Levites (and behemtam of the Israelites, both of them) signifies many, let the verse write them alike. Since the verse varied its wording, learn from this: one [animal] exempted many.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:10:1.hebrew: ופודה בו פעמים הרבה - פ"ה: אם חזר וקנאו מיד כהן אחר שנתנו לו, חוזר ופודה בו פטר חמור אחר. ור"ת מפרש דאספק קאי לקמן בפרקין (בכורות ד' ט.), דקתני רישא: "אחת בכרה ואחת לא בכרה ילדה זכר ונקבה — מפריש, והוא לעצמו"; ובספק זה שלא יצא מידו, הוצרך למתני שחוזר ופודה בו ספק אחר פעמים הרבה. וכן משמע דאספק קאי, דקתני בתר הכי: "נכנס לדיר להתעשר", ומוקי ליה בגמ' בספק. אבל בוודאי לא אפשר למימר פודה וחוזר ופודה כל זמן שהוא ביד ישראל ולא נתן, דהא תנן לקמן בפירקין (בכורות ט.): "שתי חמורות שלא בכרו וילדו שני זכרים — נותן שני טלאים לכהן":
Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:10:1.english: "And he may redeem with it many times" - Rashi explained: If he went back and purchased it from the priest after having given it to him, he may repeatedly redeem another firstborn donkey with it. And Rabbeinu Tam explains that it refers to a case of uncertainty later in our chapter (Bekhorot 9a), as the first clause teaches: "[If of two donkeys,] one had previously given birth and one had not given birth, [and they] gave birth to a male and a female, he designates [a lamb], and it is for himself." And regarding this case of uncertainty, where [the lamb] did not leave his possession, [the mishna] needed to teach that he may repeatedly redeem another case of uncertainty with it many times. And indeed it is implied that [the mishna] refers to a case of uncertainty, as it teaches subsequent to this: "[The lamb] enters the pen to be tithed," and the Gemara establishes it [as referring] to a case of uncertainty. However, in a case of certainty, it is impossible to say [that] he may redeem and repeatedly redeem as long as [the lamb] is in the Israelite's possession and he has not given [it to the priest], for behold, we learned later in our chapter (Bekhorot 9a): "[If] two donkeys had not previously given birth and gave birth to two males, he gives two lambs to the priest."

Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:11:1.hebrew: לא קדשו בכורות (נמי) במדבר - לא בכור אדם, ולא בכור בהמה. והא דפריך לעיל: "אפי' מבכור בהמה טהורה ליפטרו, דהא בהמה טהורה דידהו הפקיעה בהמת ישראל הטהורה" — אין זה אליבא דריש לקיש לפי סברתו של עכשיו. ומיהו, לפי מסקנא דלקמן — הוקדשו בחומש הפקודים ואחר כך פסקו — ניחא:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:11:1.english: "The firstborn were not (also) sanctified in the wilderness" - Neither human firstborn nor animal firstborn. And as for that which [the Gemara] challenged above: "Even from [the requirement of offering] a firstborn of a kosher animal they should be exempt, for their [the Levites'] kosher animals exempted the kosher animals of the Israelites" — this is not in accordance with Reish Lakish based on his reasoning at present. However, according to the conclusion below — [that] they were sanctified in the Book of Numbers and afterward [the sanctity] ceased — it is well [understood].

Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:19:1.hebrew: אותו היום - מכאן ואילך לא קרוב. ואע"ג דנדרים ונדבות קרוב משם ואילך, משום בכורות נקט "אותו היום":
Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:19:1.english: "That day" - From here onward they were not offered. And even though vow offerings and gift offerings were offered from that point forward, it formulated [the phrase] "that day" on account of the firstborn [offerings].

Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:24:1.hebrew: אלא אי איתמר כו' - למסקנא זו, לא נאמרו הני תיובתא דלעיל. וכה"ג איתא בריש החולץ (יבמות דף לה: ושם) גבי אלמנה מעוברת, ובפרק קמא דחגיגה (דף ז.), ופרק המפלת (נדה דף כד.) גבי פניו מוסמסין; ובכמה דוכתי איכא טובא:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:24:1.english: “Rather, if it was stated, etc.” - According to this conclusion, those refutations from above were not stated. And a similar case is found at the beginning of HaCholetz (Yevamot 35b and there) regarding a pregnant widow, and in the first chapter of Chagigah (7a), and [in] the chapter [entitled] HaMappelet (Niddah 24a) regarding “its face was macerated”; and in several places there are many [such cases].

Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:4:1.hebrew: מה לכסף שכן פודין בו הקדש ומעשר שני - אע"ג דהקדש נפדה בשה וכל דבר חוץ מעבד וקרקע ושטר, כדאמרינן בפ' יש בכור (לקמן בכורות דף נא.) — היינו מטעם ששוה כסף ככסף, ולא מטעם שה. אבל פטר חמור נפדה בשה כל דהו, ובשאר — בשויו, כדאמר לקמן:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 4b:4:1.english: "What [is notable] about silver? That one redeems consecrated property and second tithe with it" - Even though consecrated property is redeemed with a lamb and [indeed] with anything except for a slave, land, and a document, as we say in the chapter [entitled] Yesh Bekhor (below, Bekhorot 51a) — that is [only] by virtue of [the principle] that an item of monetary value is [treated] like money, and not by virtue of [it being] a lamb. But a firstborn donkey is redeemed with any lamb whatsoever, and with other [items only] at its value, as [the Gemara] states below.
